methodology: Preliminary verse-specific triage based on known narrative content; primary texts not independently collated in this session. Locators are research leads, not public verified citations. No literary dependence inferred.

records.topic: Noah denies being in error and identifies himself as messenger
records.notes: Genesis 6–9 does not preserve this exact exchange with community leaders; absence remains provisional.

records.topic: Noah conveys divine messages and offers sincere counsel

candidates.similarity: Noah receives divine communication concerning impending judgment
candidates.difference: Genesis narrates instructions to build the ark, not Noah's public declaration of counsel to leaders
candidates.composition_and_manuscript_dates: Unresolved: composition date must be distinguished from extant manuscript witness date.
candidates.publication_gate: Staging only until primary-text, edition, dating and scholarly review.

records.notes: Compare possible Jewish and Syriac preaching traditions; do not treat ark instructions as the same speech.

records.topic: A human messenger from among his people warns of judgment

candidates.similarity: Divine judgment against human wrongdoing is impending
candidates.difference: Genesis does not narrate the rhetorical question about a human warner from the community
candidates.composition_and_manuscript_dates: Unresolved: composition date must be distinguished from extant manuscript witness date.
candidates.publication_gate: Staging only until primary-text, edition, dating and scholarly review.

records.notes: Seek specific pre-Islamic textual witness to Noah's public warning; broad motif alone is insufficient.

records.topic: Noah rejected; he and ark companions saved; rejecters drowned

candidates.similarity: Noah and those with him survive in an ark while a flood destroys others
candidates.difference: Genesis supplies animal pairs, flood chronology and family detail; Quran 7:64 frames destruction as response to rejecting prophetic signs
candidates.composition_and_manuscript_dates: Unresolved: composition date must be distinguished from extant manuscript witness date.
candidates.publication_gate: Staging only until primary-text, edition, dating and scholarly review.

records.notes: Potential strong narrative relationship, but translation and critical-edition collation pending; compare Genesis 7 and 8 without importing details into Quran 7:64.

records.topic: Hud is sent to ʿAd, calling to worship God alone
records.notes: No independently established pre-Islamic primary-text account of Hud preaching to ʿAd located in this preliminary pass. Do not equate ʿAd with a named archaeological culture without evidence.

pending_questions: Verify original Arabic Qur'an and exact biblical Hebrew and a named critical translation for each candidate.
